checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One assembled 15-second 16:9 film with three garden scenes
must.why: One 15.1 s widescreen clip. The frames show three different garden shots: the pot, the man approaching, and the hands plus the close-up.

must.item: Both leads resemble the portraits, including her curly dark hair and his short grey hair
must.why: She has dark curly hair and he has short grey hair with stubble. The likeness is reasonable but not exact.

must.item: Woman visibly reacts with disappointment to the empty pot before the reveal
must.why: Frame 1 shows her frowning at the empty pot of soil.

must.item: Man reveals a small flowering plant from behind his back, then both place it in the pot together
must.why: The two-handed placement of the pink geranium is clear. The reveal moment is not shown in the sampled frames.

must.item: Ending shows both smiling and no audible soundtrack
must.why: Both are smiling broadly at 14.3 s. The file has sound with a peak of -9 dB, so I cannot tell whether it is silent.

faults.what: The reveal from behind the back is not visible in the sampled frames, so I cannot confirm it. At 10.6 s the plant is already being placed.
The faces fit the references only loosely, especially the woman in profile and in the close-up. The man's age and look are close.
The audio has a peak of -9 dB, so the file has sound even though the request was for silence. The content cannot be judged.
The woman looks more puzzled or frowning than sad in frame 1. At 10.6 s her mouth is open and she looks surprised.

summary: A good, realistic garden film with a clear arc and a warm ending where both leads smile, and the faces match the portraits well enough. The reveal is not visible in the sampled frames, and the audio track may not be silent.
